run.label: rider-returns-support
run.note: 22-Nov-2026 18.21-18.42 IST on test.gokesari.com, on the owner's request: the full rider delivery file (orders-delivery), then the returns and support files, desktop + phone, suite 99074595 (staging head). It repeats the run of 21-Nov 10.27 IST, which lost the Mac's internet connection at about 10.30 (ENOTFOUND test.gokesari.com) and was not collected; that run's return RT-42749AED, left with the rider, was cancelled as operations at 18.20 IST before this run. Customer 1's wallet was topped up Rs 5,000 on the owner's OK on 21-Nov 10.24 IST. 100 rows: 94 pass, 6 blocked: TC-FLD-089 desktop + phone (customer at the open cash-on-delivery limit, E-16), TC-DEL-018 / TC-DEL-024 (no second staging rider session), TC-DSP-015 (no shop B owner session), TC-FLD-103 (by design: the contact page has no message field).
